currentWork.title: Field maintenance — compact sold-out display + continued visit machine context
currentWork.releaseStatus: A FINAL.20 bounded field hotfix is preview-verified. Compact sales-journal review now shows a sold-out section only when OCR returned soldOuts. Same-visit continuation now carries the already-confirmed visit machine context into the next input/recovery review so the operator is not asked to create another durable vendor→machine link for the same visit. The later paper keeps its own maker/vendor identity; persistence re-reads the exact Analytics visit before draft creation, inherits its trusted machineId, and fails closed if the new paper's concrete machine candidate conflicts. No new durable machine mapping is created automatically. Dedicated soldout/visit-context, OCR field, visit-closeout/overlap, and same-visit continuation gates pass on the READY preview. App/engine/DB/schema remain FINAL.20 / AN14B3B5 / 4 / 4.
scope: Show sold-out rows in the compact sales review only when soldOuts is non-empty.
After explicit continue-capture from a confirmed report, display the same trusted visit machine on the next related paper and suppress redundant re-link UI when there is no conflict.
Before draft persistence, re-read the exact open visit and inherit its trusted machineId rather than relying on UI inference.
Do not create a durable mapping for the later paper's maker/vendor automatically.
Fail closed if a concrete candidate on the continued paper identifies a different machine.
Keep explicit paper approval, explicit formal confirmation, inventory semantics, Analytics engine, DB and schema unchanged.
nextActions: Merge the bounded hotfix after diff/status review.
Verify production/live sold-out display and same-visit no-relink behavior with regression gates.
Return to field use and real evidence accumulation.
